paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The plot, titled "INSPIRED," illustrates the performance of two different models measured by Recall@50 and NDCG@50 across a sequence of five steps. The x-axis lacks an explicit label, utilizes a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, and features tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot includes two y-axes to accommodate the different metric scales: the left y-axis is labeled "Recall@50," uses a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, and has tick labels spaced by 0.1; the right y-axis is labeled "NDCG@50," uses a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.35, and has tick labels spaced by 0.05. There are four lines in the plot. The line representing "Recall@50 (Ours)" is a solid green line with circular markers corresponding to the left y-axis; it shows a steady upward trend, starting at approximately 0.36 at x=1, passing through 0.49 at x=3, and ending at a peak of roughly 0.56 at x=5. The line for "Recall@50 (ReFICR)" is a green dotted line without markers, also corresponding to the left y-axis, which remains entirely flat across the x-axis at a constant value of approximately 0.33. The line for "NDCG@50 (Ours)" is a solid blue line with square markers corresponding to the right y-axis; it exhibits a steady upward trend, beginning at approximately 0.21 at x=1, passing through 0.24 at x=3, and ending at roughly 0.26 at x=5. Finally, the line for "NDCG@50 (ReFICR)" is a blue dotted line without markers, corresponding to the right y-axis, that remains constant and flat across the entire x-axis at a value of approximately 0.11.
